scope: Proposition 2.2 (Winning partition from the wide box) of the manuscript “Deterministic quasipolynomial-time mean-payoff games” (preprints/Deterministic-quasipolynomial-time-mean-payoff-games-September-25-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 104 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 5d8d8876fd2982fd), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 6. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let h be the box solution in [0, D0]V . Then Vlo = {i : hi ≤ nW}, Vhi = {i : hi ≥ D0 − nW} partition V . There is a positional Max strategy under which every play starting in Vhi has original mean payoff at least zero. There is a positional Min strategy under which every play starting in Vlo has original upper limiting average at most −1/n. Both assertions allow arbitrary history-dependent opposition.
